svg.title: Traceweave local-only extraction and comparison workflow
svg.desc: Four steps run strictly inside a local boundary on your machine: Source Work, Extract, Catalogue, and Compare. Raw content never leaves your machine. Optionally, a Reproducible Evidence Report containing byte spans and SHA-256 digests can be shared and re-verified offline.
